verdict.rationale: Ghostty's docs say it ships hundreds of built-in themes, each selectable with one line of config, and that themes switch automatically with system dark/light mode. Users can also author their own themes. Community posts praise related colour options (minimum-contrast, selection colours), but no hands-on report covers theme switching itself. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of automatic light/dark switching, in-depth reference docs on theme config syntax.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can apply color schemes and themes, including automatic light/dark mode switching

citations.quote: Ghostty ships with hundreds of themes that can be selected with a single line of configuration.
Themes can be switched automatically based on system dark/light mode.
Ghostty ships with hundreds of built-in themes, supports different themes for light and dark mode, and more.
Users can author their own themes.
